description:
Start a 30-day trial, no card. After that, $1 per account per month for 3 pixels and 500 new contacts per UTC calendar month.

        Sends a 6-digit code to the email address. Returns account_id and signup_token; keep both.
        Next: ask the person for the 6-digit code in the AgentPixel email, then call confirm_signup(account_id, code, signup_token).
        The signup_token lasts 24 hours.

code.description: Optional trial code from a directory or listing, such as SMITHERY60. An unknown code never blocks signup. Example: GLAMA60
code.title: Code

display_name.description: Name shown on the account, such as the person's name or the business name. 1 to 200 characters. Example: Pat Lee
display_name.title: Display Name

email.description: Email address of the person who will own the account. The 6-digit code is sent here. Ask the person for it; never invent or guess an address. Example: pat@example.com
email.title: Email

name: signup_free
title: Start 30-day trial
